messages.title: Here's what's new in Shots Studio 1.9.52! 🚀
messages.message:
You've made your Screenshot manager! 🎉

What's new:

 - Collections from search 
 Enhanced image zooming in full screen.
 Animations and UI updates 
 Fixed the App crash on restart bug 

Check out the changelogs for the full logs!

With ❤️,
Team Shots Studio
